name: browser-errors-empty
goal: Represent unavailable and empty browser diagnostic records without implying a passing test.

evidence: BrowserErrors renders no DOM for an absent or empty diagnostics collection; isolated component screenshots are blank. Distinguish unavailable diagnostics from an explicitly empty collection without calling either a successful test.

The component catalog has diagnostic-attempt examples but no absent or empty collection variants. Add both to the existing catalog scenario and assert neutral messages; retain quiet behavior in the Reports and Desktop test consumers.
